kjv: hired the Syrians of Beth-rehob ... and of Ish-tob twelve thousand men
mine: hired the Arameans of Beth-rehob ... and the men of Tob, 12,000 men
note: 'ish tov means "the men of Tob" (a region; cf. Judg 11:3). It is not a place called Ish-tob. The KJV also uses "Syrians" for 'aram throughout, an anachronism for the Arameans.
